name: Washington Health (Fremont) High School Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Hospital volunteer roles for high school students at Washington Hospital in Fremont. Openings depend on what the hospital needs.
who_can_apply: Age 16 or older. Seniors are told not to apply because onboarding is long (a college program exists).
deadline_text: Next high school round is Fall 2026. The waiting list closed May 22, 2026, but new students can still join and are contacted only when an info session is scheduled.
how_to_apply: Email volunteer_services@washingtonhealth.com with your name, grade, school, phone and email. They contact you only when an info session is scheduled. Phone 510-818-7465.
notes: No GPA rule or fee appears on the current page (older versions listed a GPA rule and $20 fee). Openings are limited. Office: 2500 Mowry Ave, Fremont.
